text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
ââ!?
Making your move hereâare you, Gimlet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Kris S.
Show me—your submission.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With this, the epic poem is complete!
Uraaaagh!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-hahaha!
Fools who cannot see the bigger picture!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "I've been waiting for this moment! When you fools rush forward like wild boars, blind to everything else!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wide open! Both generals, taken down!
Zuuu-oryaaaaaaah!!"clean

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's No Reason, it's No Reason!
Glory without a reason, No Reason!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take thaaaaat!!
The enemy has been slain~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet and Symboli Kris S.
The two clashing fiercely――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason cut right through with a single stroke,
snatching the glory right out of their hands.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwahaha, worked like a charm!
Trainer, doesn't that feel refreshing?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahahaha!
Good, good, this feels truly delightful.
It is positively dreamy!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Sing and dance! Today, all formalities are out the windowww!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason was in high spirits.
And then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Gimlet, Lord Kris S, our spring has come to an end.
However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The final crown still remains.
The autumn Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Needless—to say.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... You preach the path to the fourth ice wall, do you,
commander of the east?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
By the way... Lord Gimlet, after running today,
something crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: We're quite similar, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Similar—did you say?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, the arrogance in your running in particular is quite similar.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That makes me even less willing to back down!
Especially to you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a resemblance of souls? If so—
then one half of this alter ego must fall to the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Only one may pass through the gates of hell.
Perish, or make me fall!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Clashing in full glory before scattering is the true flower of battle!
Though naturally, I shall not be the one to scatter.
Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the two have in common.
It isn't just arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A certain kind of "purity of resolve."
It's because she has this that, quirky though her personality may be,
she somehow remains refreshing.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is the Kikuka Sho... but I highly
doubt getting there will be a smooth road.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Feels like something is about to happen again, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Failing to register for the Satsuki Sho.
And the utter chaos before the Japan Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things keep happening to the point where one might wonder if she's possessed by a vengeful spirit.
Chances are, something will happen next time, too...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: However, we must endure! Just one more battle remains until we clear the gateway of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "The Kikuka-sho! I shall reach it without fail and smash through all misfortune!"
